en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a semi-rural hillside area with terraced slopes covered in vineyards or fields. A prominent baroque-style church or monastery with twin towers and a dome stands on top of the hill to the left. Below are orchards with rows of small trees, a walled complex of buildings, and a straight paved road with early streetlights, where a few pedestrians walk. On the right are two multi‑storey masonry houses along the road. Handwritten numeric markings appear along the left edge of the image, suggesting a catalog or postcard notation.
